themes.name: Hang tag · dark
themes.usage: Set by Settings → Theme (Dark, or Match device). Re-derived from the same kraft and green hues; all 26 text/status/border pairs measured: lowest board-muted on board 5.43:1, text ≥4.5:1, borders ≥3:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main page background — kraft paper. ink, ink-muted, price and brand all read at ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: Lighter paper for text-heavy work areas: Farmer/Admin dashboards, tables, long forms. ink and ink-muted ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The face of a tag: cards, product tags, forms, dropdowns, dialogs. ink/ink-muted/price/danger ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: image placeholders, the pickup strip inside a ticket, map background before tiles load. ink and ink-muted ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Deep green band: header, footer, hero band, highlighted stat tile. Only on-board / board-muted go on top.

tokens.name: on-board
tokens.usage: Primary text on board.

tokens.name: board-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav links on board.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-quiet, surface-raised, surface-sunken, brand-tint, highlight.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: Farmer name, unit, time, form hints. On surface, surface-quiet, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative rule: image borders, light dividers. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tag borders, input borders, checkboxes, unselected chips, ticket tear line — ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Twine green: primary buttons, links, selected chip/slot/tab. Usable as text on every surface and on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Brand on hover/press. on-brand still ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-strong.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Light brand fill: selected slot, 'ready' badge, selected table row.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Price-tag yellow: PriceTag fill, 'Fresh today' flag, stall marker, count badges. Only on-accent goes on top — NEVER white text.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent on hover/press (accent button).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent and accent-strong.

tokens.name: price
tokens.usage: Price figures when not on the yellow tag (tables, cart, totals).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline + 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors, cancel, delete, decline. Text on surface-raised and danger-bg; fill for the destructive button in a dialog.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fill (confirm cancel/delete in Dialog).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error message and error toast background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success confirmation: 'Order placed' toast, saved check.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info Banner background (e.g. cart split into several orders).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on info-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning background: cutoff approaching, low stock.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-bg.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Background of unread notifications and new rows in the Farmer orders table.

tokens.name: twine
tokens.usage: Twine color — decoration only (cover string, header line). Never for text or meaningful borders.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark overlay behind a Dialog.

tokens.name: pin-market
tokens.usage: Market marker on the map (square pin).

tokens.name: pin-stall
tokens.usage: Stall marker on the map (round pin) — differs from pin-market in both shape and color.

tokens.name: status-placed-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Placed (waiting for the Farmer)'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-placed-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-placed-bg, ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-accepted-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Accepted by the Farmer'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-accepted-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-accepted-bg, ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-ready-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Ready for pickup'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-ready-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-ready-bg, ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-completed-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Picked up — unlocks reviews'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-completed-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-completed-bg, ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-declined-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Declined by the Farmer'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-declined-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-declined-bg, ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-bg
tokens.usage: Badge background for 'Cancelled by the customer'. Always paired with a word + glyph (OrderStatus).

tokens.name: status-cancelled-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on status-cancelled-bg, ≥4.5:1.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Home hero, market name on the board band. One line per screen at most.
styles.sample: Picked this morning, sold by noon

styles.name: type-h1
styles.usage: Page titles (market name, stall name, 'Cart', 'My orders').

styles.name: type-hand
styles.usage: Handwritten labels: 'Fresh today' flag, Farmer notes, market day on the hero. Never for form labels or buttons.

styles.name: type-price-lg
styles.usage: Price on the product detail page, ticket total, big dashboard figures.

styles.name: type-h2
styles.sample: This week at Vườn Cô Tư

styles.name: type-h3
styles.usage: Product and stall names in cards, dialog titles.

styles.name: type-body-lg
styles.usage: Intro paragraph on About Us, stall description.
styles.sample: Pre-order now, pick up at the stall on Saturday morning. Pay on pickup.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Pre-order now, pick up at the stall on Saturday morning. Pay on pickup.

styles.name: type-small
styles.usage: Meta: Farmer · market, unit, time, form hints.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: Image captions, notification timestamps. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: type-overline
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above headings, table column headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between glyph and text in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between adjacent buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical control padding; gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; 375px mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a page; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero/board band padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections at 1440px.

radius.note: Paper tags get a medium corner (10px); controls a light one (4px); chips are fully round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, slots, price tag, pickup strip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product/stall/market cards, tickets, banners — like the corner of a cut paper tag.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, status badges, chat bubbles.

shadow.note: No blurred shadows on cards. A paper tag only has a 2px thick bottom edge; blurred shadows are reserved for floating layers (dropdown, dialog, toast).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The thick edge of a paper tag: cards, tickets.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, map popups, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, day chips, slots — minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards, filter chips.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: SiteHeader height.

tokens.name: size-container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on desktop.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky SiteHeader.

tokens.name: z-map-popup
tokens.usage: Popup on the Leaflet map (Leaflet panes go up to 400 — put custom popups inside a Leaflet pane).

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, search suggestions.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile test width (FR-080). One column.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet width. Two card columns, filters move into a drawer.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop width. 1200px max container, list and map side by side.
